nodes.label: Real Estate Properties (core module)
nodes.rationale: Remains the authority for persistence and invariants; adapters validate transport input but never own the rules.

nodes.label: Real Estate Properties API
nodes.rationale: Validates transport input and delegates mutations to the core action, so the versioned contract can change without moving invariants out of the core.

nodes.label: /api/v1/real-estate versioned namespace
nodes.rationale: Each -api package owns one versioned path segment under a shared namespace, so a module's transport can version independently of its domain core.
